## ABOUT

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
My name is Rimjhim Saxena (Pronounced : *Rim-Jim Sax-éna*)

I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at [University of Colorado, Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/economics/). I like working at the intersection of Climate + Labor + Development, preferably with a good coffee.

Before starting graduate school, I worked as a Research Assistant at [Center for the Advanced Study of India, University of Pennsylvania](https://casi.sas.upenn.edu). I hold a Masters degree in Economics from [Boston University](https://www.bu.edu/econ/), MBA in Finance and Bachelors in Industrial Engineering from Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, India (#10 engineering school in India, #997 globally).

I also worked as a Pre-Doctoral Fellow at [Environmental Defense Fund](https://www.edf.org) in Summer of 2021 under the Office of Chief Economist.
